bibl.title: Some Controversial Topics in the Derveni Cosmology.
bibl.seg: Richard D. McKirahan, Some Controversial Topics in the Derveni Cosmology.

Christian Vassallo (ed.), Presocratics and Papyrological Tradition. A Philosophical Reappraisal of the Sources. Proceedings of the International Workshop held at the University of Trier (22-24 September 2016) = Studia Praesocratica. 10 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 73-90.
bibl.note: 1. How closely is DC [Derveni Cosmology] related to DM [Derveni Myth]? - 2. How appropriate is it to use Presocratic cosmologies as keys to understanding DC? - 3. How early did the sun exist? - 4. Where does night fit into the cosmogony? - 5. What does DA [Derveni Author] mean by "dominate" (ἐπικρατεῖν)? - 6. (A) In what sense are all things called Zeus? or (B) In what sense is Zeus called all things? - 7. Will the cosmos last forever? - Appendix of texts.
